nodes.name: Weekly — Monday 8am
nodes.notes: Runs Monday 08:00 in GENERIC_TIMEZONE (see .env.example). Change the cron for the client's reporting day/time.

nodes.name: Metrics: Facebook (stub)
nodes.notes: STUB — Connect: 'Query Auth' credential (access_token = Page token; never inline it) + real PAGE_ID. /insights takes metric= (not fields=). Meta retires Page Insights metrics periodically — confirm the metric names against the current Graph API version before activating.

nodes.name: Metrics: Instagram (stub)
nodes.notes: STUB — Connect: same Query Auth credential + real IG business account ID. Account fields (followers_count) live on /YOUR_IG_BUSINESS_ID, not /insights. Confirm metric names against the current Graph API version.

nodes.name: Metrics: Site (stub)
nodes.notes: STUB — Connect: whatever the client uses (Google Analytics Data API, Plausible, Wix analytics export). Returns trailing-7-day sessions, top pages, referral sources. Put any API key in an n8n credential, not the URL.

nodes.name: Compile markdown digest
nodes.notes: Connect: edit the template below for the client's KPIs. Reads the three metrics nodes, which run in sequence so all three have data when this runs (parallel branches would fire this node — and the Telegram send — once per branch). For Scout: this is the data source for the weekly performance report; Scout appends what won to the brand's learnings.md.

nodes.name: Send to operator (stub)
nodes.notes: STUB — Connect: Telegram bot credential + real chat ID, or swap for an email node (SMTP credential) to mail the report. The digest markdown comes from the previous node. Telegram caps messages at 4096 characters — the text is truncated; email the full digest if it runs long.
